# 1308 Studio

> Luxury hair salon & spa in Savannah, GA. Hair coloring & styling, eyelash extensions, brows, and head spa services, delivered by European-trained stylists with Southern hospitality.

1308 Studio is located at 1308 Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Savannah, GA 31415. Free parking is available in front of and behind the building. Rated 4.9 stars from 48+ Google reviews.

- Phone: +1 912 800 0555
- Hours: Mon-Fri 10 AM-6 PM, Sat 9 AM-3 PM, Sun by appointment only
- Booking: via Vagaro (linked from every page)
- New guests: 10% off first visit
